guide.summary: Customers in other workspaces can be served only by a public OAuth integration, because scoped integrations are limited to selected workspaces. Each customer authorizes separately and chooses pages in the page picker. The read content capability is the least privilege that covers reading titles and content. Pages must be shared with the connection, and each workspace's authorization is handled individually. Setup, consent and token exchange remain untested.
